correctness.rationale: Read actual Git RESULT.md blob 4f0df2764d9f56f6a059f7f64d8cfa1230839af0 and verification/verify.py. Reversible positive t=z^1/4 parametrization away from t=1 yields θ(t)=(t⁴+t³+t²+t+2)/(t(t²+t+1)); the three-state Markov transition matrix splits into antisymmetric spin-2/3 mode and a lumped 2-state mode. Independent Sympy characteristic polynomial and exact integer identities confirm λa=1/((t+1)(t²+1)) and λb=t³(t+2)/((t+1)(t²+1)(t⁴+2)); their ordering changes at t=1. For t>1, 2λb<1 follows from a polynomial in s=t−1 with positive coefficients (6,14,36,59,54,28,8,1); for 0<t<1, 2λa>1 iff cubic t³+t²+t−1<0. θ′(t)<0 on 0<t<1 and at unique root ρ, θ=2(1+ρ). Hence KS sufficient non-extremality criterion 4λ*²>1 holds exactly when t<ρ; no converse/reconstruction conclusion is drawn.
